name: Pine Ridge Roofing — Post-call follow-up
note: Make scenario exports include account-specific custom webhook and connection identifiers. Build this flow in Make, then export its official blueprint from the scenario editor. This file is an implementation mapping, not a Make import file.

trigger.dedupeImplementation: Use a Make Data Store keyed by eventId. Create the key before any external notification; route an existing key to a no-op path. If a later module fails, mark the key failed and allow an operator to replay after checking whether the side effect completed.

reliability.errorHandler: Use Make incomplete executions and an error handler that records eventId, callId, module, and a redacted error. Do not log the full transcript, phone, address, or tokens.
reliability.replay: Before manual replay, check whether the downstream operation completed to avoid duplicate notifications.
reliability.privacy: Pass only the fields needed by each downstream module; keep the raw transcript out of this scenario.

routes.name: Urgent lead
routes.action: Create an operator review task or notify a configured dispatcher. Only configure a real notification after an approved destination is supplied.

routes.name: Routine follow-up
routes.action: Add a standard follow-up task or notify a configured dispatcher. Only configure a real notification after an approved destination is supplied.
